scripts.build: pnpm generate:openapi && pnpm build:emails && pnpm build:web && cargo build --workspace
scripts.build:web: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web build && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web build
scripts.build:analyze: ANALYZE=true pnpm --dir apps/drive-web build && ANALYZE=true pnpm --dir apps/identity-web build
scripts.check:size: tsx scripts/check-bundle-size.ts apps/drive-web/dist && tsx scripts/check-bundle-size.ts apps/identity-web/dist
scripts.check: pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:nx-boundaries && pnpm check:web && pnpm check:api
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web format:check && pnpm --dir apps/drive-web lint && pnpm --dir apps/drive-web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web format:check && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web lint && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web typecheck && vp check libs/ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts
scripts.format: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web format && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web format && vp fmt --write libs/ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts && cargo fmt --all
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web format:check && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web format:check && vp fmt --check libs/ts package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts && cargo fmt --all --check
scripts.lint:web: pnpm --dir apps/drive-web lint && pnpm --dir apps/identity-web lint && vp lint libs/ts/http-client libs/ts/identity-client libs/ts/identity-sdk libs/ts/identity-sdk-web libs/ts/web-runtime libs/ts/email-templates package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml vite.config.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm check:structure && pnpm check:nx-boundaries && pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test
